nodes.label: Belajar KKPRL public learning reference
nodes.summary: PRD for anonymous PDF and external-video references managed in the existing Layanankkprl Filament panel; Category > Group > Material, with search, filters and anonymous counters.
nodes.rationale: A small public reference library helps users find trusted requirements without learner accounts or LMS complexity.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Category Group Material hierarchy
nodes.summary: Each learning group belongs to one category; each material belongs to one group. Category, group and material tables are separately managed.
nodes.rationale: Grouped themes support public filtering and discovery without a course enrollment model.

nodes.label: Anonymous PDF and external video access
nodes.summary: No public login; PDFs open inline or download; videos are external URLs; no uploaded-video hosting or learner personal data.
nodes.rationale: Keep trusted references accessible and avoid hosting video or tracking individual learners.

nodes.label: Hierarchical publication visibility
nodes.summary: Active category plus published group plus published material required; inaccessible slugs return 404 and missing PDFs return 404.
nodes.rationale: Parent publication status must also gate direct material access.

nodes.label: Anonymous learning popularity counters
nodes.summary: Opening a material increments views; PDF download increments downloads, with no learner progress tracking.
nodes.rationale: Admins need simple popularity feedback without personal learner data.

nodes.label: Layanankkprl learning administration
nodes.summary: Existing Filament panel contains Kategori Pembelajaran, Grup Pembelajaran and Materi Pembelajaran, following Shield authorization.
nodes.rationale: Reuse existing panel, style and permission pattern rather than a separate LMS or panel.
